message: Plan a fictional museum reopening. Facts: reopening date is June 15; staffing is short by 8 docents; HVAC testing finishes in 5 days; donor preview is fixed for June 12; only 2 mitigations can be chosen for the first week; list exactly 3 follow-up checks. Break the work into exactly three parallel specialist tracks and then one final joiner step that merges the specialist outputs into one memo. Keep the memo under 180 words.
